Note that dist[idx2(j, i, n)] == dist[i * n + j],\n    // i.e. row i (all destinations j) is contiguous in memory, and\n    // dist[idx2(j, k, n)] == dist[k * n + j], so the pivot row k used by\n    // every rank each iteration is also contiguous. Each rank keeps its own\n    // authoritative copy of the rows it owns and receives the current pivot\n    // row from its owning rank via broadcast.\n    size_t rowBegin = 0, rowEnd = numNodes;\n    std::vector<int> rowOwner(numNodes, 0);\n    if (numRanks > 1) {\n        computeRowRange(numNodes, numRanks, rank, rowBegin, rowEnd);\n        for (int r = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Broadcast the current pivot row (dist[k][*]) from its owning rank\n        // so every rank has an up-to-date copy for this iteration.\n        if (numRanks > 1) {\n            MPI_Bcast(&dist[k * numNodes], static_cast<int>(numNodes),\n                      MPI_UNSIGNED, rowOwner[k], MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        }\n\n        // For each source node i owned by this rank\n        for (size_t i = rowBegin; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n\n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Gather each rank's authoritative row block back into rank 0's full\n    // matrices for validation/printing.\n    if (numRanks > 1) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(numRanks), displs(numRanks);\n        for (int r = 0; r < numRanks; ++r) {\n            size_t b = 0, e = 0;\n            computeRowRange(numNodes, numRanks, r, b, e);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((e - b) * numNodes);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(b * numNodes);\n        }\n        const int myCount = counts[rank];\n\n        MPI_Gatherv(rank == 0 ? \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for computeRowRange(const size_t numNodes, const int numRanks, const int rank,\n                     size_t& rowBegin, size_t& rowEnd) {\n    const size_t base = numNodes / rowEnd = rowBegin + base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes,\n                   const int rank, const int numRanks) {\n    // Row-wise block decomposition: each rank owns a contiguous range of\n    // source nodes \"i\". }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of Summary of changes:\n\n**`floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp`**: Parallelized with MPI using a 1-D row-block decomposition of the outer source-node loop. Each rank owns a contiguous range of rows `i`; for every pivot `k`, the owning rank broadcasts the pivot row (`MPI_Bcast`) and all ranks update their own rows independently — this maps cleanly onto the existing memory layout since both the pivot row and each owned row are contiguous in memory. Initialization is deterministic and replicated on every rank (cheap, O(n²)), so no communication is needed to reach a consistent starting state, and results are gathered to rank 0 (`MPI_Gatherv`) for validation/printing. Verified bit-identical hashes between 1, 3, 4, and 8 ranks (including cases where ranks don't divide evenly or exceed node count), and measured near-linear speedup (1150ms → 618ms → 298ms for np1/2/4 at n=1000).\n\n**`floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`**: Added `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and linked `MPI::MPI_CXX`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":418,"cache_read_input_tokens":54007,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":418},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"460baa8d-dc16-48e1-9660-dec89ec6eb79","uuid":"7b3a1ea0-7a23-4153-a4c6-f42b18439c6e","timestamp":"2026-09-14T02:37:23.487Z","request_id":"req_011Cf2Z8JvZPJm5zJ7d1EHkH"}
